diagnosis.cause: The final publication negative control mutates question_budget.question_budget_id to RESET, but validate_checkpoint budget invariant checks only used_before_pts=118, reserved_pts=52 and remaining_before_pts=882. Therefore the mutated checkpoint still passes the budget invariant and the negative control is not rejected. Publication exits with code 4 before staging or accepted checkpoint write.
diagnosis.scientific_effect: NO_ACCEPTANCE; technical publication-gate failure only. It does not invalidate the 62/62 validator or 19/19 postaccept results, and it does not consume V142.
diagnosis.required_future_fix_if_ingestion_authori: A new versioned task may strengthen validate_checkpoint budget binding to include question_budget_id (and preferably parent_ledger_version/reservation identity) and then rerun the full new-identity chain. V146 itself must not be patched or retried.
